items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: when I started the Second Herd and he came back in the band

ctx.x: And that was really my basic thinking, because Davy had been through every Dixieland contingent and through every other kind of contingent. Name it, he'd been there.

And, of course, when he had to leave the band and the guys made the replacement, really, because I did not know Don Lamont at that point at all. He was the discovery of the band, and then I found another kind of drummer who had a lot of Davey's attributes but also had something else going -- technique and fly and the fact that he was into the new music, very much so.
